# CYTOKINES 

## Within class
```{r}
cytokine_data <- read.csv("Data/Cytokine Data/Analysis Data/Cytokine_Data_ED2WK6M_analysis.csv")

cyto_df <- cytokine_data %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  left_join(
    RRS_df_median_2wk %>%
      mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
      dplyr::select(PID, RRS_median_group),
    by = "PID") %>%
  filter(
    RRS_median_group %in% c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS"),
    Timepoint %in% c("ED", "WK2", "M6"))

cyto_cols <- cyto_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-X, -PID, -Timepoint, -RRS_median_group) %>%
  names()

cyto_long <- cyto_df %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, RRS_median_group, Timepoint, all_of(cyto_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(cyto_cols),
    names_to = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Value")

cyto_wide <- cyto_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = Value)

cyto_interval_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(intervals)),
  function(i) {
    comp  <- intervals$Comparison[i]
    time1 <- intervals$time1[i]
    time2 <- intervals$time2[i]

    cyto_wide %>%
      dplyr::group_by(RRS_median_group, Cytokine) %>%
      group_modify(~ run_paired_interval_test(.x, time1, time2)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        Comparison = comp,
        .before = 1
      )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(RRS_median_group, Comparison) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(`P Value`, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(RRS_median_group = factor(RRS_median_group, levels = c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS")))

cyto_interval_results <- cyto_interval_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Comparison, RRS_median_group, Cytokine, FDR, `P Value`, `Avg Δ (WK2 − ED)`, `Avg Δ (M6 − WK2)`,`Avg Δ (M6 − ED)`, `T Stat`, `SE`, `95% CI`, `Avg ED`, `Avg WK2`, `Avg M6` ) 


# EXPORT ------------------------------------------------------------
wb <- createWorkbook()

header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center")
body_style   <- createStyle(halign = "center")

add_sheet_with_data <- function(wb, sheet_name, data) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, data)

  addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, header_style,
           rows = 1, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), gridExpand = TRUE)

  if(nrow(data) > 0) {
    addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, body_style,
             rows = 2:(nrow(data) + 1), cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), gridExpand = TRUE)
  }

  setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), widths = "auto")
}

sheet_order <- expand_grid(
  RRS_median_group = c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS"),
  Comparison = c("ED_vs_WK2", "WK2_vs_M6", "ED_vs_M6"))


for(i in seq_len(nrow(sheet_order))) {

  group_i <- sheet_order$RRS_median_group[i]
  comp_i  <- sheet_order$Comparison[i]

  sheet_data <- cyto_interval_results %>%
    filter(as.character(RRS_median_group) == group_i, Comparison == comp_i) %>%
    arrange(`P Value`)
  
  sheet_name <- paste(group_i, comp_i, sep = "_")
  add_sheet_with_data(wb, sheet_name, sheet_data)
}

saveWorkbook(wb, "2WK Analyses/Cytokines/EDWK2M6_cytokines_within_class_results.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

cyto_interval_results_export <- cyto_interval_results %>%
  dplyr::rename(Interval = Comparison ,
                `RRS Group` = RRS_median_group) %>%
    mutate(
  Interval = case_when(
    Interval == "ED_vs_WK2" ~ "ED vs WK2",
    Interval == "WK2_vs_M6" ~ "WK2 vs 6M",
    Interval == "ED_vs_M6" ~ "ED vs 6M",
    TRUE ~ as.character(Interval)
  ), 
    `RRS Group` = case_when(
    `RRS Group` == "High_RRS" ~ "High RRS",
    `RRS Group` == "Low_RRS" ~ "Low RRS",
    TRUE ~ as.character(`RRS Group`)
  ),
   Direction = case_when(
      Interval == "ED vs WK2" & `Avg Δ (WK2 − ED)` > 0 ~ "Higher at WK2",
      Interval == "ED vs WK2" & `Avg Δ (WK2 − ED)` < 0 ~ "Higher at ED",
      Interval == "WK2 vs 6M" & `Avg Δ (M6 − WK2)` > 0 ~ "Higher at 6M",
      Interval == "WK2 vs 6M" & `Avg Δ (M6 − WK2)` < 0 ~ "Higher at WK2",
      Interval == "ED vs 6M" & `Avg Δ (M6 − ED)` > 0 ~ "Higher at 6M",
      Interval == "ED vs 6M" & `Avg Δ (M6 − ED)` < 0 ~ "Higher at ED",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(Interval = factor(Interval, levels = c("ED vs WK2", "WK2 vs 6M", "ED vs 6M"))) %>%

  arrange(Interval, `RRS Group`, `P Value`)  %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), format_num))

write.csv(cyto_interval_results_export, "2WK Analyses/Cytokines/EDWK2M6_cytokines_within_class_results.csv")
```

## Figure 6f
```{r}
selected_cytokines <- cyto_cols

selected_cytokines <- c("IL_6", "TNF_alpha", "IFN_gama","IL_8", "IL_10")


plot_df_cyto <- cyto_long %>%
  filter(RRS_median_group %in% c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS"),
         Timepoint %in% c("ED", "WK2", "M6"),
         Cytokine %in% selected_cytokines) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("ED", "WK2", "M6")),
    time_days = case_when(
      Timepoint == "ED" ~ 25,
      Timepoint == "WK2" ~ 50,
      Timepoint == "M6" ~ 160
    ),
    Cytokine = factor(Cytokine, levels = selected_cytokines),
    RRS_median_group = factor(
      RRS_median_group,
      levels = c("Low_RRS", "High_RRS"),
      labels = c("Low RRS", "High RRS")),
    Cytokine = recode(
      Cytokine, 
      "IFN_gama" = "IFN-γ",
      "IL_10" = "IL-10",
      "IL_6"  = "IL-6",
      "IL_8"  = "IL-8",
      "TNF_alpha" = "TNF-α")) %>%
  group_by(RRS_median_group, Timepoint, time_days, Cytokine) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Value))),
    .groups = "drop")

cytokine_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_df_cyto,
  aes(
    x = time_days,
    y = mean_value,
    group = RRS_median_group,
    color = RRS_median_group
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se),
    width = 2,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Cytokine, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0,180),
    breaks = c(25, 50, 160),
    labels = c("", "", ""),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.04))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cytokine Level",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = function(x) {
      r <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      seq(r[1] + 0.06 * diff(r), r[2] - 0.06 * diff(r), length.out = 3)
    },
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low RRS" = "#8D1946", "High RRS" = "#2A93B5")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "plain", size = 7, margin = margin(b = 2)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 7),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = "black", size = 7, margin = margin(r = 1)),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0, "pt"), 
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5),
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -5), 
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20)
  ) 
cytokine_plot

```
